title: Shuka 1.0 Introduction
summary: Sarvam AI introduced Shuka 1.0 on August 13, 2024 as an open-source audio-language model extending a Llama 8B model to support Indian-language voice input and text output.
significance: A documented public introduction of an open audio-language model designed for Indian-language speech interaction.

geography.note: Sarvam AI's first-party launch announcement is datelined Bangalore, India, on August 13, 2024. This records only the announcement location and does not infer training, development, or release geography beyond that sourced statement.

verification.note: Sarvam AI's first-party product-launch post is dated August 13, 2024 and explicitly lists Shuka 1.0 among the products introduced that day, describing it as an open-source AudioLM and an audio extension on a Llama 8B model supporting Indian-language voice input and text output. LINEAiGE does not adopt the source's marketing superlative or comparative accuracy claim. No ancestry, influence, causality, separate development date, or relationships are inferred.
